cards.prompt: Put the three areas of life in the order listed: work, relationship to self, relationship to others.
cards.answer: Work, then relationship to others, then relationship to self.
The capability to act and actively shape your circumstances.

cards.prompt: A person is equally high-agency in every area of life.
cards.answer: People are selectively agentic: they excel in some areas and are stuck in others.

cards.prompt: At 25 you conquer fears at work but still cannot fix the anxiety you had at 15. What explains this?
cards.answer: You are high agency at work but low agency in relationship to self; your persistence is not applied to the anxiety.

cards.prompt: Which area is the hardest to change?
cards.answer: Relationship to others, because we carry social expectations from how we first learned to behave.

cards.prompt: Someone says thank you easily to new colleagues but not to their closest family. Why?
cards.answer: New people have no expectations of them, so they can rebuild their image; close people hold old expectations that make appreciation feel awkward.

cards.prompt: Explain like I'm 10: why might someone feel more loving in English than in Indonesian?
cards.answer: Each language comes with its own culture and rules. A person can be comfortable showing love in one language and shy in another, so they feel like two personalities.
